in_sanskrit.name: मणिक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is adorned with precious gems.

in_hindi.name: मणिक
in_hindi.long_meaning: मणि: कानप्रसाद (jewel), ज्वाला (flame), कान (eye); कानप्रसाद: देखने वाला (one who is seen), प्रसन्न होने वाला (one who pleases); मणिक: कानप्रसाद वाला (one who is seen and pleases), मणि (jewel), ज्वाला (flame), कान (eye).

in_marathi.name: Manik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gem, Precious Stone

In Hindu mythology, Manik is also the name of a divine being, Lord Shiva, who is often depicted wearing a crown made of precious gems. The name is believed to bestow the qualities of courage, strength, and prosperity upon the bearer.
